businesses.business: road and infrastructure construction and hot-mix asphalt paving

offering_description.value: Builds and maintains roads, highways, bridges, airport runways, parking lots and other infrastructure, mainly for state and local transportation agencies and private developers. Produces hot-mix asphalt at its own plants and owns aggregate quarries and supply yards. Work is done by its own crews and equipment.

primary_services.value: road and highway paving; infrastructure construction; asphalt maintenance and resurfacing; site preparation and grading; bridge and drainage work

customer_segment.value: B2G: state departments of transportation, counties, municipalities, airports; B2B: private developers, commercial and residential site owners, contractors

end_markets.value: public roads and highways; airports; commercial real estate; residential development; infrastructure

revenue_model.value: project or contract: paving and construction contracts won through public bidding and private work; product sales: hot-mix asphalt and aggregates sold to third parties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: construction contractor using asphalt, aggregates and equipment, serving public agencies and private owners; OEM / manufacturer: produces hot-mix asphalt at own plants from purchased liquid asphalt and quarried aggregates

geography_served.value: US regional: Southeastern and Southwestern states including Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Oklahoma

specialization.value: related lines: paving and civil construction, asphalt production, aggregates and materials

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: competitive bidding and negotiated contracts with agencies and private customers; own locations: company-owned asphalt plants and aggregate facilities

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, air quality and workplace safety rules (EPA, OSHA, MSHA), plus state DOT contractor prequalification requirements
